issues.description: In the problem statement students are instructed to call `setup_env()` with no parameters, but the provided solution calls `setup_env` with one argument (`push 1` before `call setup_env`) and performs stack cleanup (`add esp, 4`). This makes the expected interface/calling convention of `setup_env` inconsistent across artifacts and can confuse students about how to correctly call it.
issues.suggestedFix: Make `setup_env` usage consistent: either update the solution to call `setup_env` without pushing an argument (and remove the corresponding `add esp, 4`), or update the problem statement to specify the required argument(s) and calling convention.
